section_completion_log.section_name: Quality and efficiency of the implementation

revision_actions.description: Populate indicative per-work-package and per-partner person-months in Tables 3.1a, 3.1b and 3.1f, marked provisional, so effort appropriateness can be assessed.
revision_actions.reason: Person-months require an agreed consortium effort split, which no confirmed Tier 3 source carries (§13.3); for this lump-sum topic cost-bearing effort is set against the externally validated budget (§13.4). Tables 3.1a, 3.1b and 3.1f mark every person-month cell 'not agreed'/'TBD'. Populating them is deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle once participation and the budget are confirmed; Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision.

revision_actions.description: Strengthen the capacity case by confirming beneficiaries that meet the composition condition on evidence and by securing a second partner for the freshwater and marine realms.
revision_actions.reason: Confirming beneficiaries and securing a second freshwater (P07) and marine (P08) partner requires project facts absent from Tier 3 (§13.3): all twelve partners are operator assumptions and P07–P12 are fictional gap partners. Participation cannot be fabricated to satisfy the composition and capacity case; deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle in B.3.1/B.3.2.

revision_actions.description: Add a target range or a dated baseline-and-method to each of the twelve KPIs in B.1.1 so the objectives are measurable.
revision_actions.reason: KPI targets are a consortium commitment; B.1.1 states 'Target numbers are not yet fixed' and no confirmed participation exists in Tier 3 to anchor them. Deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle in B.1.1.

revision_actions.description: Back the four design choices and three assumptions in B.1.2 with cited prior results and one quantified comparison against current reconciliation practice.
revision_actions.reason: No cited prior results or quantified comparison exist in the current draft; risk R05 records that no methodology vault backs the concept. Adding citations requires new evidenced prose absent from the tiers; deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle in B.1.2.

revision_actions.description: Close the fourth destination impact's valuation clause by adding environmental-economics capability, or state which part of the impact the evidence base alone satisfies.
Give a target range or baseline-and-method for each of the twelve impact indicators in B.2.1 so the pathway magnitude is assessable.
revision_actions.reason: Impact indicator targets are a consortium commitment; B.2.1 states no target numbers are fixed and partner participation is unconfirmed. Deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle in B.2.1.

revision_actions.description: Confirm the partners carrying the uptake, protocol-transfer and standards routes in B.2.2, or add a fallback channel for each.
revision_actions.reason: Confirming the uptake (P05), protocol-transfer (P06) and standards (P10) partners requires confirmed participation absent from Tier 3; B.2.2 marks each assumed and offers no fallback channel. Deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle in B.2.2.

revision_actions.description: Add work-package and milestone months against the assumed 48-month duration in Tables 3.1a and 3.1d, marked assumed, so the timeline and critical path are legible.
revision_actions.reason: The canonical reference pack fixes deliverable months only, not work-package or milestone months; Tables 3.1a and 3.1d mark these 'not stated'. Deriving assumed months requires new prose not present; deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle in B.3.1.

revision_actions.description: Add gender-of-research expertise to the consortium through a partner or advisory role and name its place in the work plan in B.3.2.
revision_actions.reason: No partner records gender-of-research expertise (B.3.2 flags the gap); adding a partner or advisory role is a new project fact absent from Tier 3. Deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle in B.3.2.

revision_actions.description: Name the analytical method and reporting deliverable for the sex- and gender-disaggregated analysis in the gender-dimension paragraph of B.1.2.
revision_actions.reason: The B.1.2 gender paragraph disaggregates practitioner and decision-maker participation and response by sex and gender but names neither an analytical method nor a reporting deliverable; adding them requires new prose. Deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle in B.1.2.
